links.outcome: Comparison of four LLMs against manual reference standard on same medication data
links.effect: Phase 1 accuracy: Claude 99.1%, Gemini 98.7%, ChatGPT-3.5 75.4%, Copilot 74.7%; Gemini and Claude significantly outperformed ChatGPT-3.5 and Copilot (all P < .001).
links.quote: Both Gemini and Claude significantly outperformed ChatGPT-3.5 and Copilot (all P < .001).

links.outcome: LLM classification accuracy against manual ground-truth reference standard
links.effect: Accuracy against manual reference varied widely; Gemini 99.6%, Claude 99.4%, ChatGPT-3.5 81.0%, Copilot 79.7% post-feedback; only Gemini and Claude suitable for automated classification.
links.quote: Overall, only Gemini and Claude reached accuracy and macro-F1 suitable for automated antimicrobial classification.

unlisted_practices: Providing targeted feedback on a sample of misclassified cases to improve LLM classification accuracy
